channel.title: Twilio incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Twilio's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays and Failures from a Subset of Twilio Alphanumeric Sender IDs to Robi Bangladesh [investigating]
item.description: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays and failures from a subset of Twilio Alphanumeric Sender IDs to Robi network subscribers in Bangladesh. Our team is actively investigating this issue. We will provide another update in 4 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays and Failures from Twilio to Telefonica Spain [resolved]
item.description: This Incident has been resolved as we observed recovery and stablity in SMS Delivery Delays and Failures from Twilio to Telefonica Network in Spain.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to MTN Congo [monitoring]
item.description: We have observed a recovery in SMS delivery from Twilio to MTN network subscribers in Congo and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 4 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

item.title: MMS Delivery Delays and Failures from a Subset of Twilio Short Codes to Multiple Networks in United States [investigating]

item.title: Retroactive Incident: Twilio Personalized Support Phone Line Affected [resolved]
item.description: Intermittent dropped calls were reported on the Twilio personalized support hotline between 2026-08-24 08:10 AM PT and 2026-09-01 10:27 AM PT. The root cause was identified as a bug within Twilio Studio. A patch has been applied, and service has been fully restored.
